metadata.title: How to push up ✅
Strengthen Your Core 💪 #shorts #yoga #fitness #strength
YOGA X CALISTHENICS | Combined into ONE FLOW

recommendations.note: Don’t let your hips sag; keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core and breathe in as you lower down, exhale as you push up. You should feel your chest and triceps working, and your core stabilizing. Maintain control throughout the movement.
